why: Both moved the same four chat call sites cleanly with the same two plugin-path fixes, honest loss accounting and live Router evidence, but A's system judgment is more granular and covers more Router surface: six independently approvable branches with per-call-site reasoning (summarise on a cheap model, vision held back and measured separately for the reasoning-token risk under VISION_MAX_TOKENS=300, Flex/tier priced and deliberately pinned off, cache key plus labels, timeout, fallbacks) against B's three items that map one model uniformly onto all four sites. B is the better migrator — it alone found the jpeg/png mislabel and alone forced an outage through the app to test its own fallback — but as proposals its set is coarser, skips tier entirely, and drops caching on a thinner argument, and neither engineer reached the CTO bar (no spend caps, shadow models, Jev, and almost no questioning whether a call should exist at all).
A_best: Per-call-site judgment with live numbers behind each: summarisation to gpt-4o-mini (-94%) because nobody reads that text, vision split off from the chat swap because a reasoning model sharing a 300-token output cap could return nothing, Flex priced and then opted out of for a user-waiting buffered path, plus two counterintuitive measured notes (gpt-4o-mini bills 8,522 input tokens for an image gpt-4o bills at 277; user budgets priced from TOKEN_PRICE rather than Router's usage.cost).
B_best: Verification that found what wrapping alone would have shipped: encode_image announced image/jpeg for PNG bytes, invisible on OpenAI and a 400 on Anthropic — found only by actually driving a second vendor — and a forced-outage run through the app that exposed its own fallback breaking the streamed plugin loop (deepseek's preamble makes the loop stop looking), a regression it reports against itself.
A_worst: It never tested a cross-vendor request, so it missed the media-type bug and then proposed claude-haiku-4-5 as a fallback candidate on the vision call site, which would 400 on every image; both the fallback and the 60s provider_timeout cut-off paths are unexercised, and there is no caps/shadow-model/Jev/Switchyard thinking and no proposal at rework scale.
B_worst: One model map applied to all four sites treats a 700-character throwaway summary, a vision reply and the main chat turn as the same decision, so the easiest large win (summarisation on something tiny) is never isolated; tier/Flex is absent, prompt caching is dropped for OpenAI on the grounds that automatic caching already hit (affinity reliability is the point of the key), and the whole set is three items with one carrying a known plugin regression.
